rationale: PINS the review-wave T6 fix: positional symbol resolution compares 1-based symbol ranges against 0-based node rows (+1 both), so same-named methods on different objects resolve to THEIR OWN body — objA.handle carries ["callA"] only, objB.handle carries ["callB"] only. Pre-fix the lookup never matched (0-based vs 1-based can never be equal) and both bodies attributed to the first-name-matched handle, colliding the qualified_calls payloads. Both owners pinned with includes AND notIncludes (CPPD10 anti-pollution pattern): an includes-only check on one symbol passes even with polluted payloads.
